profile.name: Amiya_desi
profile.intro: I'm Amiya_desi. Indie games are my main creative line; I also maintain websites and small tools. A recent highlight is DelayTrace, about time delay and action replay

columns.title: Creative practice
items: Indie game development: Godot, GDScript, C#, time mechanics, multi-window interaction, narrative, and puzzles
Websites and tools: personal sites, browser tools, and public side utilities such as GeoScore — not the main line
Self-hosting: Docker, VPS, Cloudflare, static sites, and blog content pipelines

items.text: DelayTrace: a Godot game about time delay, recorded actions, and replay, one of my more satisfying recent Jam results
WakeUpAtTheBorder: a Godot game mixing puzzles, dialogue, and combat, awarded second prize in the third GodotHub themed Jam track
TimeRewindLinker: a puzzle experiment with time rewind, replayed actions, and links to echoes of the past
Enhanced Save System: a modular Godot save plugin with GDScript and C# implementations
GeoScore: a public-web SEO / GEO side tool, available when useful
Mio's Window Wanderer: a multi-window narrative prototype I helped make

learning: n8n, AI-assisted development, and content pipelines
